turns.customer: I'd like to return the Swift 30 daypack from order #1043. It's unused and still in the packaging. Can I submit a return?
turns.reply:
Yes, your Swift 30 Daypack from order #1043 is eligible for return! 

To start the return, you can generate and print a return label directly from your account page on our website. Simply pack the item up unused in its original packaging along with that label and send it back. Once the warehouse receives and inspects it, your refund will be issued to your original payment method within about 5 business days.
